mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(`sleep_date`, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, SUM(`total_min`) AS `totalMin`, COUNT(*) AS `nights` FROM `family_health_sleep` WHERE `user_id` = #{userId} AND `sleep_date` BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY `sleep_date` ORDER BY `sleep_date`

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(`sleep_date`, '%Y-%m') AS `month`, SUM(`total_min`) AS `totalMin`, COUNT(*) AS `nights`, SUM(CASE WHEN `kind` = 'NIGHT' THEN `total_min` ELSE 0 END) AS `nightMin`, SUM(CASE WHEN `kind` = 'NIGHT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `nightCount` FROM `family_health_sleep` WHERE `user_id` = #{userId} AND `sleep_date` BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(`sleep_date`, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY `month`
